brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full present - build has exactly 1 piece, count piece=1

requirements.requirement: Nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: No neighboring pieces at q+/-1,r+/-1 and no level 1 piece placed; check_build meshClash clear with only one base

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in the single base
requirements.evidence: A full hex base exposes 0 drawer sockets (find_sockets drawer=0). Maximum on any single-base configuration is 1 drawer (half-n/half-s expose 1 socket on the cut face, half-e/half-w/quarter variants 0). Notch/bay drawer frames require 2-3 neighboring bases beside the empty position, which would violate the 'nothing beside' constraint. Five drawers cannot be placed without adding extra bases/levels.

finish.summary: Build contains exactly one full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with no neighbors and meshClash clear, satisfying isolation. The five-drawer requirement is impossible under the configurator rules: a solitary full base offers no drawer sockets; the most any solitary base offers is 1 (half-n/half-s cut face). Achieving five drawers would require additional bases for notch/bay frames or stacking, both prohibited by the brief.
